verses.51:58: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلۡقُوَّةِ ٱلۡمَتِينُ

meaning: The root مَتْن (matn) primarily refers to the strong, firm parts of the back, specifically the erector spinae muscles or the two fleshy portions flanking the backbone.
en_note: Statistically derived from translation co-occurrence, not a lexical definition. Highlighting only.
